newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Palestinian dies at Israeli roadblock.
newsitem.headline: Palestinian dies at Israeli roadblock.

text.p: A passenger in a car travelling from the West Bank towards Jerusalem was killed early on Wednesday at an Israeli roadblock in what Palestinians said was a deliberate shooting and Israelis termed a crash.

Israeli police said the car crashed into a truck after police shot at its tyres when the driver refused their order to stop at the roadblock. A police spokeswoman said the man's identity was not immediately known.
Jibril Rujoub, head of Palestinian Preventive Security in the West Bank, said the man was shot by Israeli undercover units. The Israeli army denied that.

Television pictures of the car by Israeli Channel Two showed the front left tyre was punctured, the front right side of the hood was bent, there was a gunshot hole in the back right window and there was no blood inside the car.
The pictures, taken after the body was apparently removed, showed the carwas standing on the side of the highway, its headlights on and intact and four Israeli police vans stationed around it.
A police remote-controlled bomb detonater went from one of the police vans towards the car and then back.
Police spokeswoman Linda Menuhin said Israeli border police at Hizmeh roadblock north of Jerusalem signalled the car heading toward the city to stop but the driver ignored them.

"The border police said they shot in the air and then the car tried to overrun them. They said they shot in the air again and at the tyres but the car didn't stop and collided with a truck," Menuhin said.

"The passenger in the car was injured and taken to hospital where he died. His identity is unknown. The driver ran away and police have taken the passenger's body to the forensic institute for an autopsy."
